brief:
Israel has intensified operations in Hebron involving mass expulsions, blockades, and expanded settler control, Al Jazeera English reported. The escalation threatens to destabilize the West Bank economy and alter the territorial balance in the strategic Palestinian city.

Hebron holds particular significance as a major commercial and population hub in the West Bank. The combined effect of displacement, economic restrictions, and settler expansion creates cascading pressures on Palestinian livelihoods and governance across the region.
dek: Mass expulsions, blockades and expanding settler control in Hebron threaten to devastate the West Bank economy.
title: Israel expands control in Hebron amid mass expulsions and blockades
